/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.name: ComparisonRunner

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.name: BenchmarkExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.doc: Executes benchmarks in various modes (Single, Multiple, Suite, Parallel).

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.name: EvaluationPipeline
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.doc: End-to-end evaluation pipeline for a benchmark.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.name: ArtifactCollector
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/runner.doc: Collects artifacts safely from a completed Mission object.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: QualityCalculator
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.doc: Calculates quality scores from ground truth comparisons.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: ScoringWeights
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.doc: Configurable weights for the scoring engine.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: MetricsRegistry

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: CoverageCalculator

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: PerformanceCalculator
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.doc: Extracts and calculates performance metrics from the mission object.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: MetricsEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.doc: Facade for the Metrics and Scoring subsystem.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.name: ScoringEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/metric.doc: Computes the final deterministic benchmark scorecard.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: HTMLRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Renders the report as a standalone HTML dashboard.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: BenchmarkReport
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: The full report generated from an EvaluationResult.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: JSONRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Renders the report as a JSON string.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: ChartGenerator
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Utility to generate text-based or HTML-based charts for reports.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: BaseRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Base class for all report renderers.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: PDFRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Renders the report as a PDF document using WeasyPrint (via HTML).

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.name: MarkdownRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/report.doc: Renders the report as Markdown suitable for GitHub/GitLab.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthSchema
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Pydantic schema for validating ground truth definitions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthValidator
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Validates ground truth definitions against the schema.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: MatchStatus
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: The classification of an expected finding against actual output.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruth
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Comprehensive definition of expected analysis outcomes for a benchmark.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: MatchResult
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: The result of comparing a single expectation against actual output.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: ComparisonResult
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: The aggregated result of all ground truth comparisons for a mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: In-memory storage for loaded Ground Truth definitions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthComparer
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Orchestrates matching across all domains between Ground Truth and Mission output.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthLoader
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Loads and instantiates Ground Truth definitions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthMatcher
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Core logic for matching expected strings/objects against actual outputs.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.name: GroundTruthEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/ground.doc: Facade for the Ground Truth evaluation subsystem.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.name: DatasetValidator
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.doc: Validates the structure and content of a benchmark dataset directory.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.name: BenchmarkDataset
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.doc: Represents a loaded benchmark dataset with all its configurations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.name: DatasetLoader
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.doc: Parses a dataset directory and builds a BenchmarkDataset object.

/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.name: VersioningManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/benchmark/datase.doc: Handles semantic versioning and compatibility checks for datasets.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: FeedbackTargetType
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: Type of the artifact the feedback is attached to.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: FeedbackEntry
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: A single piece of structured researcher feedback.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: PluginUsageStat
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: Performance statistics for a single plugin across a mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: HeuristicUsageStat
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: Performance statistics for a heuristic rule.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: MissionMetricsRecord
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: Complete performance snapshot of a mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: LearningRecord
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: Per-mission learning snapshot captured after mission completion.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: DiscoveredPattern
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc: A reusable research pattern identified from historical mission data.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..name: Recommendation
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/models..doc:
An advisory recommendation for the Mission Planner.

ALWAYS requires planner approval before any action is taken.
The Learning Engine NEVER auto-modifies execution plans or mission policy.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/recomme.name: RecommendationEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/recomme.doc:
Converts DiscoveredPattern objects into advisory Recommendation items.

Quality gate: every recommendation must contain a non-empty ``rationale``.
Recommendations that fail this check are logged and discarded.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/history.name: MissionHistoryStore
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/history.doc:
Creates, persists, and retrieves LearningRecord snapshots for missions.

Usage
-----
After a mission completes::

    store = MissionHistoryStore(registry)
    record = store.record_mission(mission)  # extract + persist

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/registr.name: LearningRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/registr.doc:
Centralized store for LearningRecord snapshots and FeedbackEntry objects.

Records are keyed by mission_id.
Feedback is keyed by target_id (investigation / hypothesis / task UUID).

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/metrics.name: MissionMetricsCalculator
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/metrics.doc:
Computes a MissionMetricsRecord from a Mission object.

Designed to be tolerant of missing or partial mission state — all
attribute accesses use safe getattr / hasattr guards so the calculator
works regardless of which engines have been initialised.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/feedbac.name: FeedbackCollector
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/feedbac.doc:
Receives researcher feedback and persists it to the LearningRegistry.

Validates that the target_id exists in the appropriate mission registry
before storing.  Validation is best-effort — if the registry is
unavailable the feedback is still recorded to avoid data loss.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/feedbac.name: FeedbackSummarizer
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/feedbac.doc: Aggregates and summarises feedback for a collection of FeedbackEntry objects.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/engine..name: LearningEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/engine..doc:
Orchestrates feedback collection, metrics computation, pattern discovery,
and recommendation generation for the Argus Learning & Feedback Engine.

/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/pattern.name: PatternDiscovery
/home/varun/argus/argus/learning/pattern.doc:
Identifies reusable patterns from a collection of LearningRecord objects.

Rules are evaluated deterministically — given the same records they always
produce the same patterns.  Patterns are advisory only; they do not trigger
any automatic changes.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ResearchContextBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Builds a concise context for the AI model from the current research state.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/copilo.name: ResearchCopilot
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/copilo.doc: The reasoning layer that identifies gaps and suggests prioritized research opportunities.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.name: ContextReference
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.doc: Represents a reference to research context (observation, evidence, workflow, etc.)

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.name: VisualObservation
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.doc: Represents a structured technical fact extracted from an image.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.name: Project
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.doc: Represents a security engagement or research workspace.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.name: WorkspaceTask
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.doc: Represents a focused piece of work inside a Project.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.name: Conversation
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/models.doc: Represents a full conversation session in the workspace.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.name: ProjectRepository
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.doc: Handles JSON-based persistence of workspace projects.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.name: WorkspaceTaskRepository
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.doc: Handles JSON-based persistence of workspace tasks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.name: ConversationRepository
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/reposi.doc: Handles JSON-based persistence of workspace conversations with fast in-memory indexing.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/provid.name: AIModelProvider
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/provid.doc: Abstract base class for all AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Local).

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/provid.name: MockModelProvider
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/provid.doc: A mock provider used for the foundation PR and testing.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/vision.name: VisionPipeline
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/vision.doc: Orchestrates image analysis and visual observation extraction.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/engine.name: ConversationEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/engine.doc: The central engine orchestrating conversational interactions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/storag.name: AttachmentStorage
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/storag.doc: Manages secure local storage for uploaded attachments and images.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextAssembler
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Formats a structured ContextResult into a Markdown string for the LLM prompt.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: MissionContextResolver
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Resolves and formats the active mission context for the AI.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextQuery
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Represents a request for research context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextSource
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Represents a single retrieved item of research context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextResult
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: The final structured context returned by the engine.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextPolicy
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Enforces authorization, scope isolation, and privacy policies on context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ContextRanker
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Ranks retrieved research context based on relevance to the query.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: KnowledgeGraphRetriever
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: Retrieves relevant entities and relationships from the Knowledge Graph.

/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.name: ResearchContextEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/workspace/contex.doc: The central orchestrator for gathering research context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: ReasoningStep
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc: A deterministic step in the reasoning chain.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: TimelineEvent
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc: A chronological event related to the investigation.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: GraphNode
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc: A node in the explanation graph.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: GraphEdge
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc: An edge in the explanation graph.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: ExplanationGraph
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc: The full graph structure explaining the investigation's provenance.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.name: Explanation
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/models.p.doc:
A comprehensive explanation object detailing why an investigation exists
and how its attributes (priority, confidence) were determined.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/renderer.name: ExplanationRenderer
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/renderer.doc: Renders Explanation objects into human-readable text.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/graph.py.name: ExplanationGraphBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/graph.py.doc: Builds a graph representing the provenance of an investigation.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/engine.p.name: ExplainabilityEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/engine.p.doc: Orchestrates generation of Explanations for Investigations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/timeline.name: TimelineBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/timeline.doc: Builds a chronological timeline of events leading up to an investigation.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/export.p.name: ExplanationExporter
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/export.p.doc: Exports Explanation objects into various formats.

/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/reasonin.name: ReasoningChainBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/explain/reasonin.doc: Builds deterministic reasoning chains tracing an investigation back to observations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/authorization/ga.name: AuthorizationGate
/home/varun/argus/argus/authorization/ga.doc: Centralized authorization gate for Argus tools and actions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/authorization/sc.name: ScopeResolver
/home/varun/argus/argus/authorization/sc.doc: Resolves and enforces authorized mission scope boundaries.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/gener.name: HypothesisGenerator
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/gener.doc: Generates Hypotheses from Investigations based on evidence thresholds.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/model.name: Hypothesis
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/model.doc:
Represents an evidence-backed research question.
A hypothesis is NOT a vulnerability.
It proposes structured areas that should be investigated further based on evidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/confi.name: HypothesisConfidenceScorer
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/confi.doc: Calculates a confidence score for a hypothesis based on its supporting evidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/templ.name: HypothesisTemplateBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/templ.doc: Generates structured reasoning and validation guidance for Hypotheses.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/engin.name: HypothesisEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/engin.doc: Facade for the Hypothesis Engine, orchestrating hypothesis generation and lifecycle.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/lifec.name: HypothesisLifecycleManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/lifec.doc: Manages the state transitions of Hypotheses and records history.

/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/ranki.name: HypothesisRanker
/home/varun/argus/argus/hypothesis/ranki.doc: Evaluates and ranks hypotheses based on evidence, impact, and confidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/manager.name: EvidenceManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/manager.doc: Manages the persistence and retrieval of research evidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.name: EvidenceRelationship
/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.doc: Represents a relationship between evidence and other entities.

/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.name: ProvenanceData
/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.doc: Tracks the origin of an evidence item.

/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.name: Evidence
/home/varun/argus/argus/evidence/model.p.doc: Represents confirmed or reviewed research evidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/cont.name: MethodologyContext
/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/cont.doc:
Wraps the Mission to provide a filtered, scope-aware context 
specifically tailored for evaluating and executing a PlaybookStep.

/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/step.name: StepEvaluator
/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/step.doc: Evaluates if a PlaybookStep's prerequisites are met within the Mission context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/exec.name: PlaybookExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/exec.doc: Executes a Playbook step-by-step against a Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/engi.name: MethodologyEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/methodology/engi.doc: Orchestrates the selection and execution of Methodology Playbooks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/prof.name: Profiler
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/prof.doc: Context manager for profiling code blocks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/sche.name: TaskScheduler
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/sche.doc: Schedules and executes tasks based on their dependencies.

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/cach.name: ObjectCache
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/cach.doc: Generic LRU Cache for managing memory and reducing duplicate objects.

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/para.name: ParallelExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/para.doc: Executes tasks in parallel using a ThreadPoolExecutor to share memory (mission state).

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/metr.name: MetricsRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/metr.doc: Centralized metrics tracker for performance monitoring.

/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/incr.name: IncrementalTracker
/home/varun/argus/argus/performance/incr.doc: Tracks dirty state and deltas for incremental processing.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/task_ge.name: TaskGenerator
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/task_ge.doc: Generates ResearchTask objects from coverage gaps and mission context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/researc.name: ResearchPlanner
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/researc.doc:
Evaluates mission state and produces a prioritized research queue.

Orchestrates:
  1. Coverage computation
  2. Gap analysis
  3. Task generation from gaps
  4. Priority scoring and dependency filtering
  5. Mission storage updates

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/planner.name: MissionPlanner
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/planner.doc: Analyzes a Mission and generates a dependency-aware Research Plan.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: TaskCategory
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: Categories of research tasks the planner can generate.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: ResearchTask
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: A single recommended research action generated by the Research Planner.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: CoverageGap
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: Describes a specific area where analysis coverage is missing or weak.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: CoverageReport
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: Tracks analysis coverage across all mission dimensions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: PlanDependency
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: Defines a dependency between two steps in the research plan.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: PlanStep
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: Represents a single executable step within the research plan.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..name: ResearchPlan
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/models..doc: The structured Research Plan generated from a Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/schedul.name: PlanScheduler
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/schedul.doc: Schedules the execution order for a Research Plan.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/coverag.name: CoverageTracker
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/coverag.doc: Computes a CoverageReport for the current mission state.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/depende.name: DependencyResolver
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/depende.doc: Resolves dependencies between steps and builds a valid execution DAG.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/decisio.name: DecisionEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/decisio.doc: Prioritizes, filters, and orders research tasks for the mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/gap_ana.name: GapAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/planning/gap_ana.doc: Identifies missing information in the current mission state.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/context..name: MissionContext
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/context..doc: Thread-safe context for accessing the currently active Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/manager..name: MissionManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/manager..doc: Central orchestrator for the Mission Runtime.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/plugins..name: PluginExecutorAdapter
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/plugins..doc: Adapts class-based internal plugins to the tool execution interface.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executio.name: ExecutionContext
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executio.doc: Provides a safe abstraction over Mission state and configuration.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: TaskState

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: RetryPolicy
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Configurable retry policy for a task.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: RetryRecord
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Record of a single retry attempt.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ScheduledTask
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: A ResearchTask wrapped with scheduling metadata.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: SchedulerEvent
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: An event emitted by the scheduler.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ExecutionQueue
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: The ordered execution queue for the scheduler.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ToolExecutionStatus
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Execution lifecycle status for a tool.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: OrchestratorEventType
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Event types emitted by the Tool Orchestrator.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: Tool
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Metadata representing an executable tool or capability.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ToolExecutionContext
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: The context injected into tools for execution.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ToolArtifact
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Artifact produced by a tool, stored with provenance.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: ToolExecutionResult
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: Standardized result wrapper for all tool execution types.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.name: OrchestratorEvent
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/models.p.doc: An event emitted by the Tool Orchestrator.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/schedule.name: MissionScheduler
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/schedule.doc:
Coordinates the high-level phases of the mission:
Recon -> Graph -> AI -> Planner -> Agents -> Execution -> Reports

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/checkpoi.name: MissionCheckpointer
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/checkpoi.doc: Handles serialization, recovery of Mission state, and logical checkpoints.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/controll.name: MissionController
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/controll.doc: Manages lifecycle and thread execution of missions via the autonomous runtime.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/mission_.name: AutonomousMissionRuntime
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/mission_.doc: The central control loop orchestrating an Argus mission from start to finish.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/history..name: MissionStorage
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/history..doc: Handles persistent storage of mission execution history, states, and metrics.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/queue.py.name: ExecutionQueueManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/queue.py.doc: Manages the lifecycle of tasks within the execution queue.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/registry.name: ToolRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/registry.doc: Registry for all executable capabilities (tools and plugins) in Argus.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/metrics..name: MissionMetrics
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/metrics..doc: Tracks performance and operational metrics for a Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/state_ma.name: MissionStateMachine
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/state_ma.doc: Manages strict state machine transitions for a Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/dependen.name: TaskDependencyResolver
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/dependen.doc: Resolves task dependencies and unblocks ready tasks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.name: TaskScheduler
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.doc: Schedules and coordinates the lifecycle of ResearchTasks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.name: ToolExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.doc: Abstract Base Class for executing tools.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.name: InternalPluginExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.doc: Executes class-based internal plugins and specialist agents.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.name: ExternalToolExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.doc: Executes command-line binary tools within the sandbox.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.name: RemoteWorkerExecutor
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/executor.doc: Placeholder for executing tools on a remote worker node.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.name: RuntimeEventType
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.doc: Events emitted by the autonomous mission runtime.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.name: RuntimeEvent
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.doc: An event emitted across the Argus platform.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.name: EventBus
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/events.p.doc: Publishes and subscribes to runtime events.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/results..name: ResultCollector
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/results..doc: Collects logs, artifacts, metrics, and state updates during tool execution.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/dispatch.name: ToolDispatcher
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/dispatch.doc: Selects and routes tool executions to internal, external, or remote execution engines.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..name: SafetyViolationError
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..doc: Exception raised when a tool execution violates scope or policy safety constraints.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..name: SafetyValidator
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..doc: Validates targets, capabilities, permissions, and operations against Mission Scope and Policy.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..name: Sandbox
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/sandbox..doc: Executes external commands inside a restricted sandbox environment.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/lifecycl.name: MissionLifecycle
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/lifecycl.doc: Manages strict state machine transitions for a Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/lifecycl.name: TaskLifecycle
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/lifecycl.doc: Manages strict state machine transitions for a ScheduledTask.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/retry.py.name: RetryHandler
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/retry.py.doc: Handles task failure logic according to its RetryPolicy.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/orchestr.name: ToolOrchestrator
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/orchestr.doc:
The Tool Orchestrator resolves task categories to compatible tools/plugins,
checks execution safety against mission policies/scopes, monitors duration,
collects artifacts, and publishes lifecycle events.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/monitor..name: ToolExecutionMonitor
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/monitor..doc: Monitors running tools, records execution duration and status, and logs lifecycle details.

/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/recovery.name: RecoveryManager
/home/varun/argus/argus/runtime/recovery.doc: Handles recovery of interrupted or failed missions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/intelligence/eng.name: VulnerabilityIntelligenceEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/intelligence/eng.doc: Reasoning engine that converts collected knowledge into structured investigation hypotheses.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/base.py.name: BaseAgent
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/base.py.doc: Base class for every Argus agent.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: AuthzHeuristicResult
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Wrapper for hypotheses returned by an authz heuristic.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: AuthzContext
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Context object passed to authorization heuristics.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: OwnershipAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Analyzes ownership chains for cross-tenant and IDOR risks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: AuthzConfidenceScorer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Scores authorization hypotheses based on evidence quality and graph completeness.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: PermissionAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Analyzes endpoints for function-level authorization risks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: RoleAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Analyzes role hierarchies for vertical privilege escalation risks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: AuthorizationSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Specialist agent for identifying authorization risks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.name: GraphHelper
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/authoriza.doc: Helper methods for extracting specific insights from the Authorization Graph.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.name: BusinessLogicPlanner
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.doc: Provides high-level guidance for investigating business logic.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.name: ObjectAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.doc: Identifies business objects and their relations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.name: BusinessLogicConfidenceScorer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.doc: Scores business logic hypotheses based on context completeness.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.name: BusinessLogicSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.doc: Specialist agent for identifying business logic risks and state machine vulnerabilities.

/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.name: TransitionAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/agents/business_.doc: Analyzes and validates allowed state transitions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/graph.py.name: KnowledgeGraph
/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/graph.py.doc: Central memory structure mapping discovered entities and relationships.

/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/workflow.p.name: WorkflowGraph
/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/workflow.p.doc: Workflow Graph for mapping multi-step business state transitions and relationships.

/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/edge.py.name: Edge
/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/edge.py.doc:
Represents a directional relationship between two Nodes in the Knowledge Graph.

Attributes:
    source (str): The ID of the origin Node.
    target (str): The ID of the destination Node.
    type (str): The type of relationship (e.g., 'HAS_ENDPOINT').
    metadata (dict[str, Any]): Additional context or properties for the edge.

/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/node.py.name: Node
/home/varun/argus/argus/graph/node.py.doc:
Represents a discrete entity within the Knowledge Graph.

Attributes:
    id (str): Unique identifier for the node.
    type (str): The category or classification of the node (e.g., 'Business Object').
    value (str): The core value or name represented by the node.
    metadata (dict[str, Any]): Additional context or properties for the node.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ge.name: InvestigationGenerator
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ge.doc: Converts Evidence Bundles into Investigations without asserting vulnerabilities.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/we.name: WeightConfig
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/we.doc:
Configurable weights for prioritizing investigations.
Default distribution reflects core priority model out of 1.0 (or 100%).

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/mo.name: Investigation
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/mo.doc:
Represents an evidence-backed area for human review.
Does NOT assert vulnerabilities or exploits.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/pr.name: PriorityEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/pr.doc:
Evaluates investigations and updates their priority, score, and explanation
without determining whether something is a vulnerability.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ma.name: ManualValidationGenerator
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ma.doc: Generates non-destructive manual validation guidance for Investigations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/bu.name: InvestigationBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/bu.doc: Orchestrator to pull bundles from Mission and queue up new investigations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/co.name: InvestigationConfidenceScorer
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/co.doc: Calculates overall Investigation confidence based on underlying Evidence Bundles.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ex.name: ReasoningTreeBuilder
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ex.doc: Builds reasoning chains explaining the provenance of Investigations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ra.name: InvestigationRanker
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/ra.doc: Sorts and filters investigations for the Priority Engine.

/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/sc.name: ScoreCalculator
/home/varun/argus/argus/investigation/sc.doc:
Calculates a 0-100 priority score for an investigation based on configurable weights and context.
MUST NOT determine vulnerability status — only prioritizes investigation opportunities based on evidence.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/obse.name: Observation
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/obse.doc: Universal Observation model produced by all Argus specialists.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/stre.name: EvidenceStrengthScorer
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/stre.doc: Calculates Evidence Strength (0-100) for Evidence Bundles.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.name: ObservationRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.doc: Centralized in-memory store for Observations across the Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.name: CorrelationRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.doc: Centralized in-memory store for Correlations across the Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.name: EvidenceBundleRegistry
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/regi.doc: Centralized in-memory store for Evidence Bundles across the Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/evid.name: EvidenceBundle
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/evid.doc:
Represents multiple pieces of evidence supporting the same application behavior
or investigation area. Fuses observations and correlations together.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/fusi.name: EvidenceFusionEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/fusi.doc:
Combines observations and correlations into unified EvidenceBundles.
Does NOT generate investigations or security conclusions.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/seri.name: ObservationSerializer
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/seri.doc: Handles serialization of Observation models across formats.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/grap.name: CorrelationGraph
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/grap.doc:
Directed graph representing relationships between Observations and Correlations.
Observations are linked to other Observations via rules, and to Correlations when grouped.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/matc.name: CorrelationMatcher
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/matc.doc: Matches observations against each other using modular rules.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/engi.name: CorrelationEngine
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/engi.doc:
Central engine for discovering relationships between observations.
Consumes observations, evaluates matching rules, and maintains correlations.
Does NOT generate investigations.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/corr.name: Correlation
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/corr.doc:
Represents multiple related observations that appear to describe the same 
application behavior or security context.

/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/dedu.name: EvidenceDeduplicator
/home/varun/argus/argus/correlation/dedu.doc: Removes duplicate evidence while maintaining provenance.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/interfac.name: ControlledMission
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/interfac.doc:
A read-only or strictly controlled interface to the Mission object.
Plugins should interact with this instead of the raw Mission.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/events.p.name: EventBus
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/events.p.doc: A lightweight in-memory event bus for Plugin pub/sub.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/authenti.name: AuthenticationIntelligenceSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/authenti.doc: Specialist agent for identifying authentication mechanisms.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.name: BusinessKnowledgeAnalyzer
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.doc: Analyzes GraphQL schema to infer business objects, relationships, CRUD ops, and workflows.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.name: GraphQLSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.doc: Specialist agent for discovering and modeling GraphQL APIs.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.name: GraphQLDiscovery
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/graphql/.doc: Discovers GraphQL endpoints from multiple evidence sources.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/file_upl.name: FileUploadSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/file_upl.doc: Specialist agent for identifying file upload and processing mechanisms.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/api/agen.name: APIIntelligenceSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/api/agen.doc: Specialist agent for identifying API resources and relationships.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.name: JavaScriptParser
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.doc:
Heuristic parser to extract AST-like structures and symbols from JavaScript.
Productionized to use pre-compiled class-level regex patterns and inline 
deduplication for improved performance and reduced memory overhead during 
large bundle parsing.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.name: JavaScriptSpecialist
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.doc: Specialist agent for discovering and modeling JavaScript files and frameworks.

/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.name: JavaScriptDiscovery
/home/varun/argus/argus/plugins/javascri.doc: Discovers JavaScript resources from multiple evidence sources.
